summary: Settings defined in a file or environment variable are read-only in the UI (for example Remote Host Headers); other system settings: analytics upload URL, subscription usage model and host metrics, activity stream (also for inventory sync), whether org admins see all users and can manage users and teams, and gathering data for Automation Analytics.
questions: Why can't I change Remote Host Headers in the UI?
How do I enable the activity stream for inventory syncs?
Can organization admins manage users in AAP?
